scripted_journeys.label: Synthetic scripted functional validation, not model performance or human usability

limitations: Local macOS/Node24/real Docker validation; remote CI matrix configured but not claimed executed.
Scripted workers prove controller behavior, not model repair performance or better human usability.
Earlier 0.5 candidate gate had a pre-worker journey interruption and resulting count failure; full raw failed evidence retained locally. Final gate is a fresh full run.
Concurrent editors are not an OS-atomic multi-file transaction; strict source drift and recovery checks apply.
